g.text: fig 5 — one matrix: what it can and cannot do

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: the whole model is x̂ = W x. every forecast step is a fixed weighted sum of the look-back window — the same weights for every window it will ever see.
